title: Struct contract — drive a multi-field, nested-struct payload end to end, and assert the multi-field command it produces (DF-27, VION-71)
description: serviceProviderSet drives a GridDemand wire struct (a bool, an enum-by-name, and a 1-level nested PowerLimits struct) into GridBlock through the real generic contract path. The block observes it and surfaces every field — including the nested ones — as service properties, asserted with expect. It then mirrors the demand onto the GridSetpoint OUTPUT contract, whose command is likewise multi-field: serviceProviderExpect asserts it one scalar at a time with `field`, including a nested one, and leaves the publish-time stamp (issuedAt, deliberately non-deterministic) unasserted. The non-HAL case the four old HAL step kinds could never address, in both directions.

steps.label: drive the grid demand (nested struct payload)
wait until the block observes the demand
the enum field deserialized by name
a nested-struct field reached the block
the other nested-struct field reached the block
fire the [Timer(1)] so the block writes the setpoint command
a scalar field of the multi-field command
a NESTED field of the command
and a relational comparator on another nested field
